locations.name: Village Street
locations.tagline: A lively neighborhood of families & workers
locations.description: A mix of customers: families, workers, ride-hail drivers. Busy on weekends, especially Saturday night. Cheap rent.

locations.name: Near Campus
locations.tagline: Across from campus, open until late
locations.description: Plenty of students who stay until late at night, but their pockets are thin. Busy on class days, quiet on weekends when campus is closed. Higher rent.

locations.name: Market Edge
locations.tagline: Next to the market: cheap ingredients, busy afternoons
locations.description: Right beside a traditional market. Ingredients are cheaper because you can grab them at the market, and from late afternoon until 21:00 it's packed with families & traders. The catch: lots of competing vendors, and once the market closes (21:30) the street empties fast, so stock has to sell quickly and you need enough seats for the afternoon rush.
perks: Lots of competition: ordinary days are a bit quieter

locations.name: Station Front
locations.tagline: Commuter crowds, customers in a hurry
locations.description: In front of the train station. Two big waves: workers heading home (17:00–19:30) and passengers off the last trains (23:00–01:00), plus lots of ride-hail drivers waiting around. Customers have more money but they're in a hurry and leave quickly if they have to wait. Busy on weekdays, ordinary on weekends. The most expensive rent.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.tagline: Ferris wheel & colorful lights until 2 a.m.
locations.description: On the edge of the night market field with a Ferris wheel and a carousel. It gets busy after evening prayers and stays packed until 02:00, peaking on Saturday night. The catch: afternoons are still quiet, weekdays are much emptier, most visitors come only once (few regulars), the noise makes customers less patient, ingredients have to be hauled from far away, and stall rent is the highest.
perks: Lots of new visitors, few regulars

locations.name: Across the Hospital
locations.tagline: A quiet road in front of the mental hospital
locations.description: Nurses, patients' families, and workers pass by every afternoon. Customers are patient and polite, but the nights get quiet early. You can get to know Ratna, a nurse at the hospital.

locations.name: Police HQ
locations.tagline: The safest spot, but the rent isn't cheap
locations.description: Officers on duty and office workers stop by before the night roll call. Busy until late, and customers have deeper pockets. You can get to know Officer Bram, who loves his coffee.
